$comment: Product photo per tablet slug, processed by `npm run tablets:images` (scripts/tablet_images.mjs). Official packshots only: front-on, plain background, one device.

aegex-10-is.note: Front-on, plain background, one device; trade-press copy of Aegex's own Aegex10 product shot (aegex.com did not respond, product discontinued). Only 250x179 px, so it will upscale ~4x and look soft; treat as a placeholder. Better-resolution alternative (900x500, angled, but also shows a battery/dock unit beside the tablet): https://mining.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/A1.jpg. Confidence: right product, weak resolution.

aegex-100m.note: No image. Tried: aegex.com (no response), web search for Aegex 100M (nothing), Aegex10 trade-press images (those show the older Aegex10 / Aegex 10 IS, not the 100M). The Eaton MTL GECMA IS tablet packshot (see eaton-gecma-is-tablet-pc) may be the same hardware family, but our sources do not confirm the 100M is that unit, so I did not reuse it.

armadex-ex-unicase.note: Near front-on (very slightly turned) render of the Ex UniCase with an iPad (A16) in it, 1000x1000, light grey background, one device. Gallery has three more views (-2 side, -3 landscape, plain file = slightly rotated). Ex and IECEx logos baked into the top corners. IMPORTANT: armadex.com returns 403 to curl and scripts (bot protection); I confirmed 200 image/png 1000x1000 only from a real browser session, so the image script may fail on it. Confidence: image correct, download may be blocked.
